offers.title: Graphics AI Software Engineer
offers.description: 🚀 We’re Growing Our Research and Innovation Dream Team! Titles? Meh, we’re not big on them, but let’s call this one Graphics AI Software Engineer 😉 As part of our international research squad, you’ll craft tailor-made solutions that wow our clients. We’re hunting for a passionate Graphics AI Soft Engineer with a solid technical background. Your mission? Train, deploy, and put groundbreaking developments into action — and that’s just the beginning. Here’s the deal: Collaborate with both research and applied engineering teams on multiple projects. Your work will involve exploring, designing, and implementing advanced AI solutions focused on computer vision, 3D rendering, and spatial computing. This role is integral to our mission of developing innovative technologies that redefine how AI enhances and interacts with 3D environments . AGILE isn’t just a buzzword here — it’s how we roll. Multidisciplinary teams? Check. Full ownership of projects? Double check. Ready to take on projects that matter, with a team that’s as passionate as you are? Let’s make it happen! 😊 You will be responsible for: Design and Implement AI-Powered 3D Graphics Solutions Develop and deploy advanced AI techniques within Desktop, Web, VR, and AR applications using our proprietary Evergine graphics engine. Your work will harness the power of AI to push the boundaries of 3D graphics performance, realism, and interactivity. Pioneer and Integrate Advanced AI Models for Computer Vision and Spatial Computing : Leverage and go beyond existing models—such as NeRF, Gaussian Splatting, Point Cloud processing techniques, SAMv2, and GroundingDINO or FlorenceV2 —to not only elevate 3D applications but also create novel, next-generation AI models that drive the future of dynamic, responsive, and intelligent 3D environments. Drive AI Innovation in Architectural Design: Lead the architectural vision for AI-driven 3D applications, playing a critical role in designing and integrating both established and newly developed machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision frameworks to achieve groundbreaking results. Develop and Scale Custom AI Solutions for Complex 3D Applications : Design original algorithms and optimize existing machine learning models for performance and scalability, enabling realistic and seamless interactions in sophisticated 3D spaces and simulations. Collaborate in an AGILE, AI-Innovation Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team focused on AGILE methodologies, where you’ll work closely with experts in AI and 3D technology, driving research and development to achieve efficient, transformative outcomes. Requirements Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to approach challenges thoughtfully and analytically, with an eagerness to learn through problem-solving. Interest in 3D Engines and Graphics Development: While prior experience with 3D engines like Unity or Unreal is a plus, a strong motivation to learn and apply these tools to create AI-enhanced interactive graphics is what truly matters. Basic Understanding of AI and Machine Learning in 3D Applications: Familiarity with concepts like machine learning, deep learning, or computer vision**, with an enthusiasm for learning how they can enhance 3D environments (e.g., NeRF , Point Cloud techniques ). Collaborative and Growth-Oriented Mindset: A strong willingness to learn, grow, and contribute within a collaborative and supportive team environment. Commitment to Ongoing Learning and Innovation: A genuine curiosity for advancements in AI and 3D technology , paired with the motivation to grow your expertise over time. Willingness to Learn AI Tools and Frameworks: Exposure to PyTorch , TensorFlow , or similar frameworks is beneficial, but the drive to gain practical experience with these tools is what’s most important. Skills to Help You Excel: Proficiency in Python and C# Fundamentals: Basic experience with Python for AI development and C# for graphics programming, with an openness to expanding knowledge in both. Understanding of 3D Graphics and Mathematics: Familiarity with key 3D concepts (e.g., vectors , matrices , coordinate systems ) and a desire to explore their real-world applications. Interest in Prototyping and Software Development: Comfort with trying out ideas through rapid prototyping and embracing disciplined software development practices. offers.title: Full Stack Developer (Python, React)
offers.description: We currently have a vacancy for a Full Stack developer fluent in English, to offer his/her services as an expert remotely (within EU) . In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the Development team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team. Your tasks: Designing and developing tools to interact with social media platforms and facilitate data collection workflows; Creating user-friendly front-end interfaces for data annotation and analysis purposes using modern frameworks and technologies; Developing back-end APIs and services to store, manage, and process data, and integrate with data analysis tools and pipelines; Writing scripts to automate tasks and workflows, using languages such as Bash and Python; Configuring and maintaining Linux-based systems for development and testing environments Ensuring the scalability, security, and performance of the tools using automation and monitoring tools; Providing technical support, troubleshooting, and maintenance for all developed tools. Requirements Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field. with relevant IT professional experience of at least 7 years; Minimum 3 years of experience in automation and scripting using languages such as Bash and Python to streamline development workflows and system administration tasks.Experience in Python, JavaScript, and web development technologies (HTML/CSS); Minimum 3 years of professional experience in full-stack web development, including designing and developing tools and applications; Minimum 3 years of experience in designing and implementing front-end interfaces using modern frameworks (such as React) and web technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript); Minimum 3 years of experience in developing back-end APIs and services using frameworks such as Flask, including database design and integration; Minimum 3 years of experience in database management systems, including both relational databases (e.g., MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB); Minimum 3 years of experience in Linux system administration, including user management, networking, security, and system configuration; Minimum 3 years of experience with containerization technologies (such as Docker) and orchestration tools (such as Kubernetes); Minimum 3 years of experience with agile development methodologies, version control systems (such as Git), and project tracking tools. Experience with automation and scripting using Bash and Python for task and workflow optimisation; Experience with agile development methodologies and version control systems such as Git; Experience with project management software such as JIRA and Microsoft Project; Experience with collaboration platforms such as Confluence and SharePoint; Knowledge of reporting methods; Certifications in web development, front-end or back-end frameworks (e.g., React, Flask, or equivalent platforms), cloud computing platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), containerization and orchestration technologies (such as Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent platforms), database management systems, software engineering, DevOps, or related fields will be an asset. Excellent command of the English language. Benefits If you are seeking a career in an exciting and dynamic company, where you will offer your services as part of a team of a major European Institution, operating in an international, multilingual and multicultural environment where you can expect real chances to make a difference, please send us your detailed CV in English, quoting reference: (20648/10/2026) We offer a competitive remuneration (either on contract basis or remuneration with full benefits package), based on qualifications and experience. All applications will be treated as confidential. You may also consider all our other open vacancies by visiting the career section of our web site ( www.eurodyn.com) and follow us on Twitter (@EURODYN_Careers) and LinkedIn. EUROPEAN DYNAMICS ( www.eurodyn.com ) is a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operating internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). The company employs over 1000 engineers, IT experts and consultants (around 3% PhD, 36% MSc and 53% BSc or equivalent). We design and develop software applications using state-of-the-art technology.
